question: What is the ranking of India in plant diversity in the world as on December 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10th.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India **ranks **10th** in **plant diversity **in the world as on **December 2010. **
 
• India is one of the **17 mega-diverse countries** in the world, with a rich variety of **flora and fauna.**
 
• It is home to about** 8%** of the world's total plant species.
 
• The plant diversity in India is distributed across various biomes, including** tropical rainforests, dry deciduous forests, alpine meadows, and mangroves.**
 
• This diversity is influenced by factors such as** climate, topography, and soil **type.
 
• The **National Biodiversity Act of 2002 **and the **National Biodiversity Authority of India** are some of the initiatives taken by the government to conserve and sustainably use the country's biodiversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The top three countries in plant diversity are** Brazil, Colombia, and China,** with around 55,000, 50,000, and 45,000 plant species, respectively.
 
• An** international** plant science journal called** Plant Diversity** (formerly known as Plant Diversity and Resources) publishes significant original research as well as review papers that enhance our knowledge of the historical and contemporary **distribution of plants **and aid in the creation of more **phylogenetically** accurate **taxonomic** classifications.
 
• The community of plant **systematic and evolutionary **biologists will find fresh information on or insights into evolutionary processes and mechanisms presented in it.
